prs.cluster_pick_reason: 1996 implements RFC 7231-style media-range parsing (splits type/subtype, handles case-insensitivity, wildcards like */* or application/*, and honors q=0 to exclude explicitly disallowed types) via a dedicated acceptsMediaType() helper. 2046 uses a plain substring check (acceptHeader?.includes('application/json')), which would incorrectly match unrelated media types containing that substring (e.g. application/json-patch+json, or a vendor type with 'application/json' embedded in a parameter) and does not honor q=0 exclusions or wildcard Accept headers. 1996's approach handles a strict superset of the cases 2046 covers.
